description: Defines the ThreadInfo structure used for capturing thread context information in Linux crash dump processing, including platform-specific register structures and methods for retrieving instruction pointers and register data.

classes.name: ThreadInfo
classes.description: Structure representing thread context information, including register states and platform-specific data, used for crash dump generation.

methods.name: GetInstructionPointer
methods.description: Returns the instruction pointer for the thread, platform-dependent implementation.

methods.name: FillCPUContext
methods.description: Fills a RawContextCPU object with the thread's register context.

methods.name: GetGeneralPurposeRegisters
methods.description: Provides a pointer and size for the general purpose registers.

methods.name: GetFloatingPointRegisters
methods.description: Provides a pointer and size for the floating point registers.
